title: Kaido device settings
description: settings.json in the app config directory. Settings of this device; never synced. Fields with invalid values fall back to their defaults when Kaido starts, and keep their current value when the file is changed while Kaido runs.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the last opened workspace, reopened on start.

recentWorkspaces.description: Recently opened workspaces, most recent first, shown on the start screen. Only the first 5 are used; extra entries are ignored.

editorFontSize.description: Text size of the note editor and the task views, in pixels.

autoSync.description: Commit and sync with git in the background. When false, only Sync now commits and syncs.

captureShortcut.description: Global shortcut that opens quick capture, as an accelerator such as "CommandOrControl+Alt+Space". null turns it off.

hideDone.description: Per workspace root, the task lists whose done tasks are hidden (workspace-relative paths; "~/all-tasks" for the All tasks view). Only the last 20 workspaces, and the last 200 lists of each, are used; extra entries are ignored.

dismissedSetup.description: Workspace roots where the suggestion to add .gitattributes and .gitignore lines was dismissed. Only the last 50 are used; extra entries are ignored.
